summary: First-finish smoke test of Construction Cost Estimator. All backend endpoints (reference, fx-rates, calculate-fast, calculate, save, list) return 200 with correct shape. Regional multiplier verified (India 8.34M < Europe 17.44M). AI insights returned with source='ai', 6 assumptions, 5 risks, executive_summary present. Frontend /estimator loads with default estimate; 6 KPIs, donut+line charts, 9 tabs, top BOQ populated, all 7 utility cards render, sidebar visible, no console errors. Currency change USD->EUR converts client-side (17,442,913 -> 15,262,741). Recalculate button triggers calculation with spinner. Step-1 jump loads Project Details form; wizard-next advances to Step 2 (Building Geometry). Tab switching (boq, utilities, assumptions) works.
passed: GET /api/estimator/reference returns all 12 dropdown keys incl. complexity[{key,label}]
GET /api/estimator/fx-rates returns base=USD with rates{} and symbols{}
POST /api/estimator/calculate-fast returns totals(cost=17.44M, confidence=92), 6 breakdown, 16 BOQ, 12 top_cost_items, utility_demand has all 7 fields, 11 months cost_trend
insights has assumptions(6), risks(5), executive_summary, source='ai'
Save returns {id, created_at}; list contains saved id
Frontend loads without console errors; sidebar 'CONSTRUCTION COST ESTIMATOR' visible
All 6 KPI cards render with numeric values; donut+line charts visible
All 7 utility cards present (water, steam, chiller, power, air, etp, fire)
All 8 output tabs present and switchable (boq, breakdown, utilities, assumptions, sensitivity, cashflow, process, infra)
Currency select USD->EUR converts KPI client-side ($17,442,913 -> €15,262,741)
Recalculate button shows spinner and refreshes
step-1 jump shows Project Details form; wizard-next advances step correctly
